tldr: AI 需求仍是市場主軸：邁威爾上調展望、戴爾財測驚艷、三星出貨 HBM4E 樣品，黃仁勳更直言台灣「不可能不成長」。
美國正式落實對台非半導體 232 關稅優惠（汽車零組件、家具、航空零件），但半導體 232 與對等關稅兩塊拼圖仍在協商。
金管會動作頻頻：普惠金融指標全達標、修正金控資本適足辦法、強化防詐遵循事項，並自 7 月調高強制車險身故失能理賠至 300 萬元。
4 月景氣燈號連亮第五顆紅燈，顯示在 AI 熱潮帶動下景氣動能穩健向上。
財管焦點：台股誕生第四檔 5,000 億元 ETF（00919），國稅局並整理遺產稅四招繳納解套，皆與高資產傳承規劃直接相關。

items.title_zh: 邁威爾上調展望反映 AI 需求暢旺　台積電受惠
items.title_en: Marvell raises long-term targets as AI demand booms, lifting TSMC
items.summary_zh: 輝達轉投資的 ASIC 暨光通訊大廠邁威爾上季財報與本季財測雙雙優於預期，並調高中長期營運目標，反映 AI 基礎建設需求火熱。利多沿供應鏈擴散：身為其晶圓代工夥伴的台積電可望直接受惠，強化客製化晶片與高速連接訂單支撐先進製程稼動率的看法，並帶動台廠 ASIC 設計與光通訊族群買氣。
items.summary_en: Nvidia-backed ASIC and optical-interconnect supplier Marvell reported last-quarter results and current-quarter guidance that both beat expectations, and raised its medium-to-long-term operating targets, citing red-hot AI infrastructure demand. The upgrade reverberates through Taiwan's supply chain: as Marvell's foundry partner, TSMC stands to benefit directly, reinforcing the view that custom-silicon and high-speed connectivity orders will keep underpinning advanced-node utilization. The read-through buoyed sentiment toward Taiwanese ASIC design houses and optical-component names tied to the AI server build-out.

items.title_zh: 兆元宴話題「詞元就是生意」　黃仁勳：台灣不可能不成長
items.title_en: Jensen Huang: "It's impossible for Taiwan not to grow"
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳在高規格聚會上表示，AI 市場規模是過去產業循環的十倍至百倍，並預言台灣供應鏈未來十年將大幅成長。談話凸顯台灣在全球 AI 算力中的結構性地位，為晶圓代工、先進封裝、伺服器、網通與散熱等本土硬體族群提供樂觀的需求背景。
items.summary_en: At a high-profile gathering themed "tokens are the business," Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argued the AI market is ten to a hundred times larger than prior industry cycles, and predicted Taiwan's supply chain will expand substantially over the next decade. The remarks underscore Taiwan's structural centrality to global AI compute and offer a confident demand backdrop for local hardware names spanning foundry, advanced packaging, servers, networking and cooling.

items.title_zh: 台達電：AI 趨勢非常好　三大事業體都有中長期規劃
items.title_en: Delta Electronics: "The AI trend is very strong"
items.summary_zh: 台達電董事長鄭平表示 AI 趨勢非常好，集團三大事業體都已備妥中長期營運規劃。作為 AI 伺服器與資料中心電源、散熱方案的關鍵供應商，台達電的樂觀表態意味雲端業者資本支出持續，也讓投資人對其電源密度與散熱需求所支撐的獲利動能更具信心。
items.summary_en: Delta chairman Cheng Ping said the AI trend is extremely positive and that all three of the group's business units have medium-to-long-term operating plans in place. As a key supplier of power and thermal-management solutions for AI servers and data centers, Delta's upbeat tone signals continued capex by hyperscalers and reassures investors that power-density and cooling demand will support its earnings trajectory.

items.title_zh: 信驊跨國合作大進擊　搶進 AI 伺服器控制層商機
items.title_en: Aspeed teams up cross-border to grab AI-server control-layer share
items.summary_zh: 伺服器管理晶片龍頭、股王信驊與萊迪思半導體建立策略合作，共同開發輔助管理晶片，深入 AI 伺服器控制層。此合作讓信驊在既有 BMC 強項之外，擴大每台伺服器的可攻含量，隨 AI 伺服器架構日益複雜、管理晶片需求上升，可望攫取增量價值。
items.summary_en: Server-management chip leader Aspeed (the "stock king") struck a strategic partnership with Lattice Semiconductor to co-develop auxiliary management chips, pushing deeper into the control layer of AI servers. The tie-up broadens Aspeed's addressable content per server beyond its BMC stronghold, positioning it to capture incremental value as AI server architectures grow more complex and management-silicon requirements rise.

items.title_zh: 台塑轉型衝刺半導體　同步布局綠能環保、醫療保健
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics pivots toward semiconductors
items.summary_zh: 台塑宣布以半導體、綠能環保及醫療保健三大方向推動轉型，並投入 292 億元投資。此舉是傳統石化龍頭尋求更高附加價值成長引擎的策略轉向，也向投資人釋出訊號：老經濟集團正將資本重新配置至以科技與能源轉型為主軸的結構性成長產業。
items.summary_en: Formosa Plastics announced a transformation along three axes—semiconductors, green energy/environmental protection, and healthcare—committing NT$29.2bn of investment. The move marks a strategic shift for a traditional petrochemical heavyweight seeking higher-value growth engines, and signals to investors that old-economy conglomerates are reallocating capital toward structural-growth sectors led by the technology and energy-transition themes.

items.title_zh: 美公告對台非半導體 232 關稅優惠　落實投資 MOU
items.title_en: US finalizes non-semiconductor Section 232 tariff relief for Taiwan
items.summary_zh: 美方公告落實非半導體三類別（汽車零組件、木製家具、航空零件）232 關稅優惠，回溯自 5 月 1 日生效，並同步落實投資 MOU。受惠類別年度對美出口約 37 億美元，對台灣傳產與運輸設備供應鏈是實質利多，也緩解相關出口商的關稅不確定性。
items.summary_en: Washington published the implementation of Section 232 tariff concessions covering three non-semiconductor categories—auto parts, wooden furniture and aircraft components—retroactive to May 1, alongside the investment MOU. The affected categories represent roughly US$3.7bn of annual exports to the US, making this a tangible win for Taiwan's traditional and transportation-equipment supply chains and easing tariff uncertainty for exporters in those segments.

items.title_zh: 性能提升逾 20%！三星全球首發 12 層 HBM4E 樣品出貨
items.title_en: Samsung ships world-first 12-layer HBM4E samples
items.summary_zh: 三星開始出貨性能提升超過 20% 的 12 層 HBM4E 高頻寬記憶體樣品，搶占 AI 加速器次世代記憶體競賽的先機。率先送樣 HBM4E 具戰略意義，記憶體廠正爭取通過 GPU 與加速器大客戶驗證；此里程碑升高與 SK 海力士、美光的競爭，也顯示 AI 記憶體升級循環正在加速。
items.summary_en: Samsung began shipping 12-layer HBM4E high-bandwidth memory samples with performance gains exceeding 20%, staking an early claim in the next-generation memory race for AI accelerators. Leading on HBM4E sampling is strategically vital as memory makers vie for qualification with key GPU and accelerator customers; the milestone intensifies competition with SK Hynix and Micron and signals that the AI memory upgrade cycle is accelerating.

items.title_zh: Nikon 擬以低價晶片設備挑戰 ASML
items.title_en: Nikon to challenge ASML with lower-cost chip equipment
items.summary_zh: Nikon 計畫推出較平價的晶片製造微影設備，與市場龍頭 ASML 競爭。雖然短期內難撼動 ASML 的 EUV 壟斷，但成熟與中階製程微影若出現有競爭力的低價替代方案，可能對價格形成壓力並提供晶圓廠第二供應來源，對整體半導體資本支出的設備成本動態值得關注。
items.summary_en: Nikon plans to introduce more affordable chipmaking lithography equipment to compete with dominant player ASML. While Nikon is unlikely to threaten ASML's EUV monopoly near-term, a credible low-cost alternative in mature- and mid-node lithography could pressure pricing and offer foundries a second source, a development worth watching for equipment-cost dynamics across the broader semiconductor capex landscape.

items.title_zh: AI 伺服器需求爆發　戴爾財測驚艷
items.title_en: Dell stuns with AI-server-driven forecast
items.summary_zh: 戴爾因 AI 伺服器需求激增，公布優於預期的財測。亮眼展望是整條 AI 伺服器價值鏈的強勁需求訊號——從 ODM 組裝、GPU 基板到電源、網通與散熱——並再次確認企業與雲端 AI 基建支出仍處上行循環，台廠伺服器 ODM 與零組件供應商可望受惠。
items.summary_en: Dell issued guidance that surprised to the upside, propelled by surging AI server demand. The blowout outlook is a strong demand signal for the entire AI server value chain—from ODM assemblers and GPU baseboards to power, networking and cooling—and reinforces that enterprise and cloud AI infrastructure spending remains in an upcycle, benefiting Taiwan's server ODMs and component suppliers.

items.title_zh: 〈COMPUTEX〉緯穎視 CPO 為未來發展重點　攜生態系夥伴展示 CPO 光互連技術
items.title_en: Wiwynn highlights CPO as a future priority at COMPUTEX
items.summary_zh: 緯穎在 COMPUTEX 將共同封裝光學（CPO）定位為重點發展方向，並偕生態系夥伴展示 CPO 光互連技術。CPO 被視為突破次世代 AI 資料中心頻寬與能效瓶頸的關鍵，緯穎以生態系為主的展示意味光互連正從概念邁向可部署的 AI 基礎建設。
items.summary_en: At COMPUTEX, Wiwynn positioned co-packaged optics (CPO) as a key development focus and showcased CPO optical-interconnect technology with ecosystem partners. CPO is increasingly seen as essential to overcoming bandwidth and power-efficiency bottlenecks in next-generation AI data centers, and Wiwynn's ecosystem-led demonstration signals that optical interconnect is moving from concept toward deployable AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布我國普惠金融指標 114 年結果，全數達標且多項優於國際平均
items.title_en: FSC: all 2025 financial-inclusion targets met, beating global averages
items.summary_zh: 金管會宣布台灣 2025 年普惠金融指標全數達標，多項指標優於國際平均值，並將於 2026 年新增 5 項指標，同步推動「全齡金融」政策與金融友善服務。結果顯示主管機關重視普及且公平的金融近用，並為銀行業以普惠為導向的商品與服務發展定調政策方向。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission announced that Taiwan's financial-inclusion indicators for 2025 were all achieved, with several measures outperforming international averages. The FSC will add five new indicators in 2026 and advance an "all-ages finance" agenda alongside financial-friendly services. The result signals regulatory emphasis on broad, equitable access and sets the policy direction for inclusion-oriented product and service development across banks.

items.title_zh: 配合保險業清償能力制度調整　預告「金融控股公司合併資本適足性管理辦法」修正草案
items.title_en: FSC pre-announces revised financial-holding capital-adequacy rules
items.summary_zh: 銀行局預告修正金控合併資本適足性管理辦法，以因應保險業清償能力制度的調整。此修正對旗下擁有大型保險子公司的金控集團尤為重要，因其重新校準集團資本的衡量方式，可能影響金控業的資本規劃、配息能力與併購彈性。
items.summary_en: The Banking Bureau pre-announced amendments to the consolidated capital-adequacy regulations for financial-holding companies, aligning them with adjustments to the insurance industry's solvency regime. The change matters for financial-holding groups with large insurance subsidiaries, as it recalibrates how group capital is measured—potentially affecting capital planning, dividend capacity and M&A flexibility across the FHC sector.

items.title_zh: 預告修正「金融機構及提供虛擬資產服務之事業或人員防制詐欺犯罪危害應遵循事項辦法」
items.title_en: FSC tightens anti-fraud compliance duties, including for virtual-asset providers
items.summary_zh: 銀行局預告修正防詐遵循事項辦法，完備跨業合作機制以強化金融防詐網絡。此舉將防詐義務延伸至傳統金融與虛擬資產服務業者，提高合規要求，反映主管機關持續將消費者反詐保護列為優先。
items.summary_en: The Banking Bureau pre-announced amendments to the compliance rules on preventing fraud for financial institutions and virtual-asset service providers, completing cross-industry cooperation mechanisms to strengthen the anti-fraud network. The move extends fraud-prevention obligations across traditional finance and crypto service providers, raising compliance expectations and reflecting regulators' continued prioritization of consumer protection against scams.

items.title_zh: 強制車險保障升級！7 月起身故及失能理賠最高 300 萬元
items.title_en: Compulsory auto-insurance payouts rise to NT$3mn from July
items.summary_zh: 保險局宣布自 7 月起調高強制汽車責任保險的身故及失能理賠額度，最高達 300 萬元。此升級強化全國事故受害人與保戶的基本保障；保險業者須在定價與準備金提存上反映較高的保額上限，是對強制險業務的一項消費者保護升級。
items.summary_en: The Insurance Bureau announced that compulsory automobile liability insurance death and disability payouts will be raised to a maximum of NT$3mn starting in July. The upgrade strengthens baseline protection for accident victims and policyholders nationwide; insurers will need to reflect the higher coverage ceiling in pricing and reserving, marking a consumer-protection enhancement to a mandatory line of business.

items.title_zh: 台股 ETF 規模創高　第四檔 5,000 億元 ETF 誕生
items.title_en: Taiwan's fourth NT$500bn ETF is born as ETF assets hit a record
items.summary_zh: 台股 ETF 總規模達 6.57 兆元新高，群益台灣精選高息 ETF（00919）於 5 月 27 日股價創高後規模首破 5,000 億元（5,030.94 億元），成為市場第四檔達此規模的台股 ETF。自 2022 年 10 月上市以來含息累積報酬 172.94%、今年來 33.13%。經理人建議分批布局、勿追高，並強調高息 ETF 易漲抗跌、適合長期存股族，對偏好現金流的客戶資產配置具參考價值。
items.summary_en: Total Taiwan equity ETF assets reached a record NT$6.57tn, and Capital Taiwan Select High Dividend ETF (00919) topped NT$500bn (NT$503.09bn) on May 27 after its price hit a new high—becoming the market's fourth ETF to reach that scale. Since listing in October 2022, 00919 has delivered a 172.94% cumulative total return (33.13% year-to-date). The manager favors phased entry over chasing highs and stresses high-dividend ETFs' "rise-easily, fall-resistant" profile for long-term holders—relevant for income-oriented client portfolios.

items.title_zh: 繳不出遺產稅　四招解套
items.title_en: Four ways to settle an estate-tax bill you can't pay in cash
items.summary_zh: 財政部高雄國稅局整理遺產稅四大繳納解套方式：延期繳納、分期繳納、實物抵繳，以及以被繼承人存款繳納，供納稅人於期限內申請。此指引對高資產傳承規劃極具實務價值——龐大但缺乏流動性的遺產常造成資金壓力，掌握這些機制可協助家族避免罰則並安排有序的跨代移轉。
items.summary_en: The Kaohsiung National Taxation Bureau outlined four routes for heirs unable to pay estate tax in cash within the deadline: deferred payment, installment payment, payment-in-kind, and settlement via the decedent's bank deposits. The guidance is practical for high-net-worth succession planning, where large but illiquid estates can create liquidity strain; understanding these mechanisms helps families avoid penalties and structure orderly intergenerational transfers.

items.title_zh: 5 月台股基金大漲 12.93%　居所有區域股票型基金之冠
items.title_en: Taiwan equity funds surged 12.93% in May—best of all regional equity-fund categories
items.summary_zh: 5 月台股基金平均上漲 12.93%，居所有區域股票型基金之冠，反映台股在涵蓋晶圓代工、先進封裝、伺服器與零組件的 AI 供應鏈動能帶動下強勢反彈。對財管客戶而言，這凸顯布局本土 AI 題材的上行潛力，也提醒在指數高檔時宜採紀律性分批配置——追高恐承受較大回檔風險，再平衡與部位控管的重要性更勝以往。
items.summary_en: Taiwan equity funds jumped 12.93% in May, topping every regional equity-fund category as the local market rallied on AI-driven supply-chain momentum spanning foundry, advanced packaging, servers and components. The standout performance shows how concentrated AI demand has translated into broad gains for domestically focused funds. For wealth-management clients it highlights both the upside of home-market AI exposure and the case for disciplined, phased allocation: with Taiwan equities having run far and fast, chasing strength at these levels carries elevated drawdown risk, making rebalancing and position-sizing discipline more important than ever.

items.title_zh: 核能與鈾礦成戰略資源焦點　009821 全台獨家 6 月 1 日重磅開募
items.title_en: Nuclear power and uranium in focus as thematic fund 009821 launches June 1
items.summary_zh: 在 AI 時代用電需求推升下，核能與鈾礦被視為戰略資源，新基金 009821 將於 6 月 1 日開募，為全台獨家商品。此商品呼應 AI 資料中心電力需求帶動核能發電與鈾燃料循環復興的結構性題材，可為客戶投組增添能源轉型主題積木；惟集中型商品／產業基金波動度高、對政策與專案時程敏感，配置比重與風險溝通需審慎拿捏。
items.summary_en: With nuclear energy and uranium increasingly framed as strategic resources for the AI-era electricity build-out, a new fund (009821) will open for subscription on June 1 as an exclusive offering in Taiwan. The launch taps the structural theme that surging AI data-center power demand is reviving interest in nuclear generation and the uranium fuel cycle. For advisers it adds an energy-transition thematic building block to client portfolios—though concentrated commodity/sector funds warrant careful sizing and clear risk framing given their volatility and sensitivity to policy and project timelines.

items.title_zh: 接班波克夏的關鍵十分鐘
items.title_en: Berkshire's ten crucial minutes: Abel steers his first solo shareholder meeting
items.summary_zh: 波克夏新任執行長艾貝爾首次獨立主持股東會，以四個策略性動作——稱呼方式、象徵性安排、巴菲特親自背書，以及強調公司核心價值觀——傳達波克夏的傳統與原則將延續，藉此穩定股東信心。這是一堂領導接班與文化延續的案例，與家族企業及高資產傳承規劃高度相關：交棒過程中守護價值觀、治理與利害關係人信任，與資產移轉本身同等重要。
items.summary_en: New Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel chaired the annual shareholder meeting on his own for the first time, using four deliberate moves—forms of address, symbolic staging, Buffett's personal endorsement, and emphasis on the firm's core values—to reassure shareholders that Berkshire's traditions and principles will endure. The episode is a case study in leadership succession and cultural continuity—themes directly relevant to family-business and high-net-worth succession planning, where preserving values, governance and stakeholder trust through a handover matters as much as the transfer of assets itself.

items.title_zh: 就保投保薪資上限擬調升
items.title_en: Employment-insurance insured-salary ceiling set to rise
items.summary_zh: 主管機關規劃調升就業保險投保薪資上限。提高上限將同時拉高保費與失業等給付的計算基礎，影響實領薪資的計算與雇主提繳；薪資接近現行上限的高薪族，在提繳與潛在給付權益上所受的直接影響最大。
items.summary_en: Authorities are planning to raise the insured-salary ceiling for employment insurance. Lifting the cap would increase both premiums and the benefit base for unemployment and related allowances, affecting take-home pay calculations and employer contributions; higher earners near the current ceiling would see the most direct impact on contributions and potential benefit entitlements.

items.title_zh: 2026 報稅／列報扶養親戚小孩　有條件
items.title_en: 2026 filing: claiming relatives' children as dependents has conditions
items.summary_zh: 報稅季進行中，國稅局說明列報扶養親戚子女須符合特定條件。納稅人必須符合既定的扶養事實與親屬關係要件才能列報免稅額；誤用規定恐遭補稅，計畫列報非直系受扶養親屬的家庭，申報前應先確認資格。
items.summary_en: As the 2026 income-tax filing season runs, the tax authority clarified that listing a relative's child as a dependent is allowed only under specific conditions. Taxpayers must meet defined support and relationship criteria to claim the exemption; misapplying the rule risks reassessment, so households planning to claim non-direct dependents should confirm eligibility before filing.

items.title_zh: 承租商辦裝修　不適用優稅
items.title_en: Office-lease fit-out costs do not qualify for preferential tax treatment
items.summary_zh: 國稅局說明，承租商用辦公空間的裝修支出不適用優惠稅率。企業在編列租賃裝潢成本時，不應假設能享優惠稅務待遇，因該支出不在適用範圍內——這對企業稅務規劃與租賃相關資本支出決策是重要提醒。
items.summary_en: The tax authority clarified that renovation and fit-out expenditures on leased commercial-office space do not qualify for preferential tax rates. Businesses budgeting tenant-improvement costs should not assume favorable tax treatment, as the expenses fall outside the qualifying scope—an important point for corporate tax planning and lease-related capital expenditure decisions.

items.title_zh: 景氣熱絡　連亮五顆紅燈　經濟動能穩健向上
items.title_en: Monitoring indicator flashes red for a fifth straight month
items.summary_zh: 台灣 4 月景氣燈號連續第五個月亮紅燈，綜合判斷分數維持 39 分，AI 應用熱潮持續推升經濟。連續紅燈代表動能強勁、接近偏熱；此數據強化國內景氣樂觀基調，同時讓政策當局留意 AI 帶動的強勢能否擴散至出口科技以外的部門。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's April business-cycle monitoring indicator stayed red for the fifth consecutive month, with the composite score holding at 39, as the AI application boom continues to lift the economy. A run of red lights signals robust momentum and overheating-adjacent conditions; the reading reinforces an upbeat domestic backdrop while keeping policymakers attentive to whether AI-driven strength broadens beyond export-tech sectors.

items.title_zh: 台美關稅優惠　差兩塊拼圖　301 調查爭取優稅不變
items.title_en: Taiwan-US tariff deal still missing two pieces; 301 probe seeks to preserve preferential rates
items.summary_zh: 在非半導體優惠落實後，台美關稅方案仍就半導體 232 與對等關稅兩項持續協商，台灣並透過 301 調查爭取維持優惠稅率不變。未決項目使關稅政策對科技供應鏈仍是現實風險，結果將影響台灣最具戰略敏感性出口品的競爭力。
items.summary_en: Negotiations continue on the remaining elements of the Taiwan-US tariff package—semiconductor Section 232 and reciprocal tariffs—even after non-semiconductor relief was finalized. Taiwan is also working through a Section 301 investigation to secure unchanged preferential rates. The outstanding items keep tariff policy a live risk for the tech supply chain, and the outcome will shape competitiveness for Taiwan's most strategically sensitive exports.

items.title_zh: 美股重點新聞摘要 2026 年 5 月 29 日
items.title_en: US stocks: daily highlights for May 29, 2026
items.summary_zh: 當日美股重點概述，盤面情緒受美伊談判進展與晶片類股（含美光的明顯波動）牽動。地緣政治頭條與 AI 記憶體動態仍是左右風險偏好的主要交叉訊號，並為亞洲市場及台灣以出口與科技為重的指數開盤定調。
items.summary_en: A roundup of the session's key US market developments, with sentiment shaped by ongoing US-Iran negotiations and chip-sector moves including notable action in Micron. Geopolitical headlines and AI-memory dynamics remained the dominant cross-currents for risk appetite, setting the tone for Asian markets and Taiwan's export-heavy, tech-concentrated index at the open.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉 Robotaxi 德州僅 42 輛　不到 Waymo 十分之一
items.title_en: Tesla's Texas Robotaxi fleet only 42 vehicles—under a tenth of Waymo's
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉在德州的自動駕駛計程車部署僅 42 輛，遠低於對手 Waymo 的車隊規模。此差距凸顯特斯拉在實際規模上仍大幅落後自駕共乘龍頭，壓抑其 Robotaxi 野心的短期預期，也突顯無人駕駛服務規模化的營運與法規門檻。
items.summary_en: Tesla's autonomous robotaxi deployment in Texas numbers just 42 vehicles, far below rival Waymo's fleet. The gap underscores how far Tesla still trails the autonomous-ride leader in real-world scale, tempering near-term expectations for its robotaxi ambitions and highlighting the operational and regulatory hurdles of scaling driverless services.

items.title_zh: 美國財長：阿曼保證不會收荷姆茲海峽過路費
items.title_en: Oman pledges no toll on the Strait of Hormuz, US Treasury says
items.summary_zh: 美國財長表示，阿曼已保證不對通過荷姆茲海峽的船隻收取過路費。此保證有利全球能源供應穩定，在中東緊張與美伊談判使原油市場敏感之際，緩解了通過此關鍵咽喉要道的油運成本尾部風險。
items.summary_en: The US Treasury Secretary said Oman has guaranteed it will not charge passage tolls on vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The assurance is positive for global energy-supply stability, easing one tail risk for oil-shipping costs through the critical chokepoint at a time when Middle East tensions and US-Iran talks are keeping crude markets sensitive.

items.title_zh: 川普肖像 250 美元紀念鈔設計完成　美國財長：需眾議院修改規定
items.title_en: Trump $250 commemorative note design finished; Treasury says House must amend rules
items.summary_zh: 美國財長宣布印有川普肖像的 250 美元紀念鈔設計已完成，但發行須經眾議院修改相關規定。該事件對市場多屬象徵意義，反映政府的財政與政治訊號；實際發行取決於立法行動，而非財政部單方決定。
items.summary_en: The US Treasury Secretary said the design of a US$250 commemorative note bearing Trump's portrait is complete, but issuance requires the House of Representatives to amend the relevant rules. The item is largely symbolic for markets but reflects the administration's fiscal-and-political signaling; actual issuance hinges on legislative action rather than Treasury alone.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 估值飆 9,650 億美元　登 AI 新創王座
items.title_en: Anthropic valuation soars to US$965bn, crowning it the top AI startup
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 估值飆升至約 9,650 億美元，成為估值最高的 AI 新創。此數字反映湧入前沿模型開發商的龐大資本，以及市場對生成式 AI 長期經濟價值的信心——並強化台灣硬體業者所服務之算力、晶片與基礎建設供應鏈的需求能見度。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's valuation surged to roughly US$965bn, making it the most valuable AI startup. The figure illustrates the extraordinary capital flowing into frontier-model developers and the market's conviction in generative-AI's long-run economics—reinforcing demand visibility for the compute, chip and infrastructure supply chains that Taiwan's hardware makers serve.
